legal_full:
Chiyambi. Tikupanga mapu otseguka kumene anthu padziko lonse amagawana miyeso ya dosimeter kuti athandize pa sayansi, chilengedwe, maphunziro ndi chitetezo. Mukafalitsa data yanu mumathandiza anthu ambiri. Chonde samalirani ntchito imeneyi ya tonse.

1) Udindo. Kulondola ndi zomwe zili mu data yomwe mumatumiza ndi udindo wanu. Data imafalitsidwa ndi kugwiritsidwa ntchito “monga ilili”. Service siyitsimikizira kulondola, kukwanira kapena kuyenera kwake pa cholinga chilichonse ndipo siyitenga udindo pa zotsatira za kugwiritsa ntchito kwake.

2) Kutseguka ndi layisensi. Mukagawana miyeso ya dosimeter, masiku, malo oyandikira, mtundu wa chipangizo kapena zina, mumavomereza kuti zidzapezeka kwa aliyense ndipo data ingagwiritsidwe ntchito mwaulere pansi pa CC0 1.0 (Public Domain), pamene code imakhalabe pansi pa MIT License. Ulembi umakhalabe wanu; palibe malipiro; kugawanso ndi anthu ena sikuli m'manja mwathu.

3) “Monga ilili” komanso popanda kuyang'aniridwa koyamba. Zofalitsa zimawoneka popanda review yoyamba. Sitingatsimikizire calibration ya chipangizo kapena kusakhalapo kwa zolakwika. Zambiri zimaperekedwa pa kafukufuku ndipo si upangiri wa akatswiri.

4) Zinsinsi ndi moderation. Kuti mapu akhale otetezeka ndi odalirika, timestamps ndi coordinates zingasinthidwe kukhala zochepa mwatsatanetsatane, ndipo metadata yaukadaulo ingachotsedwe kapena kupangidwa anonymous. Titha kubisa kapena kuchotsa spam, data yabodza, yosaloledwa kapena yosokoneza. Timayesetsa kusunga miyeso yeniyeni mosamala.

5) Cookies. Tsambali limagwiritsa ntchito session cookie yaukadaulo ya nthawi yochepa; imachoka mukamaliza ulendo wanu. Sitikusunga zizindikiro zina.

Anzathu, mapu awa ndi zotsatira za ntchito ya tonse ndi mtima wotseguka. Muwaone ngati chithunzi cha dera, osati blueprint yolondola kwambiri. Ngati ntchito yathu ikukukhudzani, lowani nawo — limodzi tingachite bwino.

legend_full:
📍 Momwe mungawerengere mapu a radiation

Scale ya mitundu ya mapu imapangitsa radiation background kukhala yooneka ndi yomveka, kuti aliyense athe kuyesa mmene malo alili ndi kusankha pa kukhala, kukhala kwakanthawi ndi radiation risks.

Mapu sagawa radiation kukhala “natural safe” ndi “technogenic dangerous”: pa dose yomweyo, natural radiation ingakhalenso risk.

Green zone sikutsimikizira kuti palibe risk konse ndipo imasonyeza ma measurements omwe alipo panopa okha.

Cholinga cha mapu ndi kuthandiza anthu kusapanga contamination yatsopano ndi kusamalira chilengedwe bwino.

Zinthu zofunika kwambiri kudziwa kuyambira pachiyambi

  • Nambala pa mapu imasonyeza gawo lokha la chiopsezo cha radiation lomwe chipangizo chingazindikire, osati chiopsezo chonse.
  • Zovuta za thanzi nthawi zambiri sizimachokera ku kukwera kwakanthawi, koma ku kukhudzidwa pang’onopang’ono kwa nthawi yaitali komwe kumasonkhana kwa miyezi kapena zaka.
  • Ngakhale dera lili lobiriwira, pangakhalebe magwero obisika monga radon, madzi kapena chakudya chodetsedwa, fumbi ndi tinthu ta m’mwamba.
  • Mapu ndi chida chothandizira, osati chitsimikizo cha chitetezo. Gwiritsani ntchito limodzi ndi kuganiza bwino, kuyeza mwapadera ndi mayeso a labotale ngati kuli kofunikira.
🟩
0–11

Dera lobiriwira

Nthawi zambiri pafupi ndi radiation yachilengedwe — koma magwero ena angakhalebe

0–11 microroentgen pa ola ndi pafupi ndi mlingo wachilengedwe womwe umapezeka nthawi zambiri.

  • Kukhala nthawi yaitali pa mlingo uwu nthawi zambiri kumakhala kovomerezeka.
  • Madzi ndi chakudya cha m’deralo nthawi zambiri n’zogwiritsidwa ntchito ngati palibe gwero lina la kuipitsidwa.
  • Mtundu wobiriwira sutanthauza kuti palibe radiation; umatanthauza kuti mlingo wakunja womwe wayezedwa uli pafupi ndi wachilengedwe.
  • Zoopsa zobisika zingakhalebe radon m’nyumba kapena radionuclides m’madzi, chakudya ndi fodya.
🟨
11–30

Dera lachikasu

Samalani ndipo pezani chifukwa

11–30 microroentgen pa ola. Nthawi zambiri palibe ngozi yomweyo, koma malo achikasu okha pakati pa zobiriwira ayenera kufufuzidwa.

  • Zingayambidwe ndi radon, gwero la m’dera, kapena kuipitsidwa kwa alpha/beta komwe chipangizo sichitha kuyeza konse.
  • Ngati munthu amakumana ndi zimenezi nthawi zonse, yesani madzi akumwa ndi chakudya.
  • Pezani gwero la mlingo wokwera ndipo muyeze radon m’nyumba.
  • Kukhudzidwa kwa nthawi yaitali kungakhale kofunika ngakhale palibe zizindikiro nthawi yomweyo.
🟥
30–100

Dera lofiira

Musalandire chiopsezo popanda kufufuza bwino

30–100 microroentgen pa ola sikuyeneranso kuonedwa ngati mlingo wamba wachilengedwe.

  • Pewani kukhala nthawi zonse mpaka chifukwa chadziwika.
  • Musagwiritse ntchito madzi kapena chakudya cha m’deralo nthawi zonse popanda kuyesa koyenera.
  • Zingayambidwe ndi radionuclides zopangidwa ndi anthu, nthaka yodetsedwa kapena radon yambiri m’nyumba kapena madzi.
  • Gwiritsani ntchito madzi ndi chakudya choyesedwa ndipo ganizirani gwero ndi nthawi ya kukhudzidwa.
⬛
100+

Dera lakuda

Kukhala nthawi yaitali si kotetezeka

Kuposa 100 microroentgen pa ola ndi mlingo waukulu wa radiation.

  • Chiopsezo chingachokere ku radiation yakunja komanso radionuclides kulowa m’thupi.
  • Madzi ndi chakudya zingakhale ndi zinthu za radioactive ngakhale zikuoneka ndi kununkhira bwino.
  • Pa ndege kapena malo okwera kwambiri, mlingo ungakweze kwa nthawi yochepa; izi n’zosiyana ndi kukhala mosalekeza m’dera lodetsedwa.

🔍 Zomwe dosimeter imasonyeza — ndi zomwe ingaphonye

Nthawi zambiri imazindikira

  • gamma radiation
  • nthawi zina gawo la beta radiation

Nthawi zambiri siyizindikira kapena imachepetsa

  • alpha radiation, makamaka zinthu za radioactive zikaloŵa m’thupi
  • radon m’mpweya wa m’nyumba ndi m’madzi
  • tritium m’madzi ndi m’mpweya
  • radionuclides m’chakudya
  • neutrons, sizipezeka kawirikawiri koma zingakhale zoopsa kwambiri
  • Choncho mtundu wobiriwira sutanthauza chitetezo chathunthu.

🧬 Momwe zinthu za radioactive zimalowera m’thupi

  • Kupuma: radon, fumbi la radioactive ndi utsi zingafike m’mapapo.
  • Madzi: tritium ndi radionuclides zosungunuka zingafalikire m’thupi.
  • Chakudya: bowa, masamba a masamba, mkaka ndi zakudya zina zingasonkhanitse radionuclides zina.
  • Kusuta: fodya ungasonkhanitse radionuclides zomwe pambuyo pake zimapumidwa.

Kukhudzidwa kwakunja kwa nthawi yochepa kapena kukhudzana kamodzi nthawi zambiri kumakhala kochepa kuposa kukhudzidwa kobwerezabwereza kapena kosalekeza; chiopsezo chenicheni chimadalira mlingo ndi radionuclide.

⏳ Nthawi ndi chinthu chofunika pa chiopsezo

Kuteteza ku radiation kumatsatira mfundo ya ALARA: kuchepetsa kukhudzidwa mpaka pamlingo wotsika kwambiri womwe ungatheke m’njira yomveka komanso yotheka. Kukhudzidwa pang’ono koma kobwerezabwereza kungapereke mlingo wochuluka kuposa kukwera kamodzi kwa nthawi yochepa. Chepetsani nthawi yosafunika pafupi ndi gwero, onjezerani mtunda ndipo gwiritsani ntchito chitetezo choyenera.

👥 Amene angakhale osavuta kuvulazidwa

Msinkhu, thanzi, mimba ndi mikhalidwe ya munthu zimakhudza momwe thupi limayankhira. Okalamba ndi anthu odwala matenda aakulu angakhale ndi mphamvu zochepa za thupi; ana ndi amayi apakati nawonso amafunika kusamala kwambiri. Kukhudzidwa komweko sikukhala ndi zotsatira zofanana kwa aliyense.

⚛️ Kubisala kwa radionuclides m’thupi

Radionuclides zina zimachita ngati zinthu wamba m’thupi: tritium imatsatira madzi, carbon-14 carbon, potassium-40 potassium, ndipo strontium kapena radium zingachite ngati calcium. Thupi lingaziphatikize m’minofu, choncho kukhudzidwa kwamkati kungakhalepo ngakhale dosimeter yakunja ikusonyeza bwino.

🗺️ Chifukwa chake mapu sayenera kukhulupiriridwa popanda kufufuza

Ngakhale mapu onse ali obiriwira, amasonyeza gawo lokha la zenizeni. Sangasonyeze radionuclide iliyonse kapena njira iliyonse ya kukhudzidwa. Gwiritsani ntchito mapu ngati chifukwa chofufuza zambiri, osati ngati chilolezo chonyalanyaza kusatsimikizika: ganizirani, yezani, tsimikizirani ndi kufunsa.

🚬 Fodya ndi zinthu za radioactive

Fodya ndi zomera zina za banja la nightshade sizoyenera ngati njira yolowera zinthu za radioactive m’thupi. Masamba a zomera amatha kusonkhanitsa ma radionuclide ambiri, kuphatikizapo polonium-210 ndi lead-210.

Pakusuta, zina mwa zinthuzi zimalowa mwachindunji m’njira zopumira limodzi ndi utsi. Choncho kulima fodya kapena nightshade zina pa nthaka yokayikiridwa kuti ili ndi radioactive contamination kenako kuzisuta ndi khalidwe loipa.

Ichi ndi chiopsezo chowonjezera cha radiation pamwamba pa zoopsa za mankhwala za utsi wa fodya zomwe zimadziwika kale.

☢️ Radiation yakunja ndi yamkati ndi zosiyana kwambiri

Radiation yakunja ndiyosavuta kuyimitsa: ngati gwero lakutali latsala m’dera, kuchoka pamalo a dose rate yayikulu, kuwonjezera mtunda kapena kugwiritsa ntchito chitetezo kumatha.

Koma ngati fumbi la radioactive latsala pa zovala kapena khungu, ndiye contamination, ndipo gwero limayenda limodzi ndi munthu.

Radiation yamkati ndi yovuta kwambiri. Zinthu za radioactive zingalowe m’mapapo ndi fumbi kapena ma aerosol, m’matumbo ndi madzi ndi chakudya, kapena kudzera pa khungu lowonongeka.

Pambuyo pake ma nucleus osakhazikika amapitiriza kuwola mkati mwa thupi mpaka zinthu zitachotsedwa kapena kuwola.

🧬 Zimene radiation imachita mkati mwa selo

Ma alpha ndi beta particles amachititsa ionization, kuchotsa ma electron m’ma molecule ndi kuyambitsa chemical reactions.

  • DNA imasunga chidziwitso cha majini. Radiation ingasinthe ma molecule ake ndi kudula ma chain.
  • Cell membrane imayendetsa kusinthana kwa selo ndi malo ozungulira ndipo ingawonongekenso.
  • Organelles ndi nyumba zamkati mwa selo, monga mitochondria zopanga mphamvu.
  • Free radicals, kuphatikizapo amene amapangidwa ndi radiolysis ya madzi, angawononge DNA, mapuloteni ndi ma membrane.

Chofunika kwambiri ndi alpha emitters mkati mwa thupi: kunja alpha particle pafupifupi silidutsa khungu, koma mkati mwa minofu limapereka mphamvu zambiri pa mtunda waufupi kwambiri.

💧 Tritium — hydrogen ya radioactive m’madzi

Tritium ³H ndi isotope ya hydrogen ya radioactive yokhala ndi half-life ya pafupifupi 12,3 years. Imatulutsa beta radiation yamphamvu yochepa kwambiri.

Tritium pang’ono imapangidwa mwachibadwa m’mlengalenga ndi cosmic radiation. Zambiri zopangidwa ndi anthu zingapangidwe mu nuclear reactors ndi malo ena a nuclear.

Kutengera mtundu wa reactor, tritium imapangidwa mu fuel, coolant ndi zinthu zina. Itha kulowa m’madzi a ntchito ndiyeno kupezeka mu zotulutsa zolamulidwa kapena kutayikira.

M’malo ozungulira, tritiated water HTO ndi yofunika kwambiri. Imasiyana pang’ono ndi madzi wamba ndipo imayenda m’water cycle: imasanduka nthunzi, imanyamulidwa ndi mlengalenga, imagwa ngati mvula, n’kulowa m’mitsinje, nthaka, zomera ndi zamoyo.

Choncho ma filter apakhomo sangathe kungochotsa tritium m’madzi ngati zinyalala zolimba.

🧬 Tritium mkati mwa thupi

Madzi a tritium akalowa m’thupi amagawikana limodzi ndi madzi wamba a thupi ndipo angafike pafupifupi minofu yonse yofewa.

Gawo lalikulu limatuluka mwachangu, koma tritium ina ingalowe m’ma molecule a organic ndi kukhala kwa nthawi yaitali.

Ma beta particles a tritium amalowa pang’ono kwambiri kuchokera kunja. Koma akawola mwachindunji mkati mwa selo, mphamvu imatuluka pafupi ndi ma molecule a biology ndipo ingayambitse ionization ndi kuwononga DNA.

Ma germ cells ndi ofunika kwambiri — ndi mzere wa maselo umene umapanga sperm ndi ma egg. Kuwonongeka kwa DNA m’selo limeneli kungasungike m’zinthu zobadwa nazo.

🔬 Chifukwa chake tritium ndi yovuta kupeza

Beta radiation ya tritium ndi yofooka kwambiri moti gamma dosimeter wamba sangathe kuiona m’madzi.

Njira imodzi yokhazikika ndi liquid scintillation spectrometry:

  1. sample ya madzi imakonzedwa ndi kutsukidwa
  2. imasakanizidwa ndi scintillation solution yapadera
  3. beta decays zimapanga kuwala kofooka kwambiri
  4. chipangizo cha low-background chimawerenga kuwalako mu zinthu zolamulidwa bwino

Pa concentrations zochepa kwambiri pangafunike kuyeza kwa nthawi yaitali ndi kuunjika tritium poyamba.

🧊 Ice yakale ndi kuola kwa tritium

Ngati madzi atalekanitsidwa ndi tritium watsopano, activity yake imachepa nthawi zonse:

  • pambuyo pa 12,3 years, pafupifupi 50% imatsala
  • pambuyo pa 25 years — pafupifupi 25%
  • pambuyo pa 100 years — zosakwana 1%
  • pambuyo pa zaka mazana angapo, tritium yoyambirira imatha pafupifupi

Choncho ice yakale ingakhale ndi tritium yochepa kwambiri yomwe inalipo m’madzi pamene ice inapangika.

Koma kusakhalapo kwa tritium sikupangitsa madzi kukhala oyenera kumwa zokha: zizindikiro za microbiology, chemistry ndi radiation zimatsalabe.

⛏️ Uranium ndi kukokolola pansi pa nthaka

Pa migodi ya uranium ya ISR/ISL — in-situ leaching, solution imapopedwa mu ore layer kuti isinthe uranium kukhala mawonekedwe osungunuka m’madzi, kenako solutionyo imapopedwanso.

Njirayi imawonjezera mwadala kuyenda kwa uranium m’madzi apansi ndipo ingasinthe kuyenda kwa zinthu zina.

Choncho m’madera a migodi ya uranium, yakale kapena ikugwira ntchito, ndikofunika kuyang’anira madzi apansi ndipo osaganiza kuti borehole ndi yotetezeka chifukwa chakuti gamma background yakunja ndi yochepa.

☄️ Ma proton ndi ma neutron a cosmic

Cosmic radiation yoyamba imapangidwa makamaka ndi ma proton amphamvu ndi ma atomic nuclei. Akamenyana ndi atmosphere, amapangidwa ma secondary neutron, proton, muon, electron ndi gamma quantum.

Pa kutalika kwa pafupifupi 9–12 km, dose rate nthawi zambiri imakhala 4–8 microsievert pa ola (400–800 microroentgen pa ola). Nthawi zina neutron zimapanga gawo lalikulu la dose imeneyi.

Mwachitsanzo, 5 microsievert pa ola × maola 700 a ulendo wa ndege = pafupifupi 3500 microsievert pachaka, kapena pafupifupi 3,5 ya malire owonjezera a anthu a 1000 microsievert pachaka.

Kwa ogwira ntchito pa ndege, exposure imeneyi ndi yofunika pa ntchito ndipo imawerengedwa ndi dose yosonkhanitsidwa.

📡 Chifukwa chake dosimeter wamba samayeza neutron bwino

Neutron ilibe charge ya magetsi, choncho gamma counter wamba si yoyenera kuyilembetsa.

Kwa ma neutron othamanga amagwiritsa ntchito moderator wolemera hydrogen, monga polyethylene kapena madzi, kenako chinthu chapadera chodziwa neutron chochokera, mwachitsanzo, ku boron-10, lithium-6 kapena helium-3.

Polyethylene yokha yozungulira gamma dosimeter yapakhomo sikokwanira kuyeza neutron dose mokwanira.

⚛️ Neutron activation

Neutron ingalumikizana mwachindunji ndi atomic nucleus. Mu ma reaction ena isotope yokhazikika imasanduka radioactive; izi zimatchedwa neutron activation.

Izi ndi zofunika makamaka mu nuclear reactors, kumene neutron flux ndi yayikulu ndipo materials a construction angakhale radioactive.

Pa kutalika kwa ndege, induced radioactivity ya thupi la munthu ndi yochepa kwambiri; chinthu chachikulu ndi dose yolandiridwa mwachindunji kuchokera ku cosmic field.

🌍 Chifukwa chake cosmic radiation ndi yochepa pafupi ndi pamwamba pa Dziko

  • Magnetic field ya Dziko imasokoneza ma cosmic particles ena okhala ndi charge
  • neutron sizisokonezedwa mwachindunji ndi magnetic field
  • Atmosphere imapanga layer yayikulu ya matter momwe particles zimachitirana ndi kutaya mphamvu
  • Nthaka, madzi, konkire ndi miyala zimapereka shielding yowonjezera

Pafupi ndi ma pole geomagnetic protection ndi yofooka, choncho pa kutalika kofanana cosmic dose nthawi zambiri imakhala yayikulu.

⏳ Nthawi ndi multiplier wamkulu wa dose

Dose rate imasonyeza mmene munthu amalandirira dose mwachangu. 110 microroentgen pa ola ≈ 10 mSv pachaka pokhapokha munthu akhale pa mulingo umenewo chaka chonse mosalekeza.

Pa internal contamination zinthu ndi zovuta kwambiri: radioactive material ili kale m’thupi ndipo ingapitirize kuunikira tissues masiku, miyezi kapena zaka.

🗺️ Chifukwa chake sitiyenera kukhulupirira mapu mwakhungu

Ngakhale mapu ali green kwathunthu, amasonyeza gawo lokhalo la radiation environment lomwe chipangizo chingayeze.

Simalowa m’malo mwa kuyeza radon, kusanthula tritium, neutron dosimetry, kusanthula madzi, nthaka, bowa, zipatso ndi zakudya zina pamene pali chifukwa.

👉 Pa moyo wautali, yang’anani osati nambala ya external background yokha, koma njira yonse ya exposure: nyumba → mpweya → madzi → nthaka → zomera → chakudya cha m’dera → thupi.

Onjezani track yanu ya miyeso pa mapu. Timathandiza .kml, .kmz, .gpx, .csv, .rctrk, .json, .log komanso ma dosimeter a RadiaCode, AtomFast ndi SafeCast.
Ngati muli ndi dosimeter ina kapena log format yanu, lembani pa GitHub ya Chicha Isotope Map — tidzawonjezera support kuti miyeso yanu ikwezedwe pa mapu.
desktop_admin_disk_notice: Chenjezo: historical import ingagwiritse ntchito mpaka ~300 GB ya disk space.
desktop_setup_intro: Mukuyendetsa Desktop mode. Konzani initial imports ndi map plugins tsopano. Mafunso awa amaoneka kamodzi kokha.
map_cache_reset_text: Izi zichotsa map tiles osungidwa ndi marker streams omwe ali mu cache ya browser iyi.
qr_modal_save_hint: Sankhani dera pa mapu pomwe chiopsezo chinapezeka ndipo pangani QR code ya dera limenelo. Sindikizani ndi kuyiyika pamalo a contamination — pa mpanda, mtengo kapena chizindikiro pafupi ndi chinthucho. Anthu adzatha kuscan code ndikuwona nthawi yomweyo dera lenileni la mapu, chifukwa cha chiopsezo ndi njira zodzitetezera.
